for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    filled=[(r_,c) for r_ in range(h) for c in range(w) if gi[r_][c]==0 and go[r_][c]!=0]
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    dom=max(cnt,key=lambda y:cnt[y])
    # for each filled cell, distances to same-color markers in its row and column
    stats=[]
    for (r_,c) in filled:
        colv=gi[r_][c]; 
        drow=min(abs(r_-rr) for rr in range(h) if gi[rr][c]==colv) if any(gi[rr][c]==colv for rr in range(h)) else None
        dcol=min(abs(c-cc) for cc in range(w) if gi[r_][cc]==colv) if any(gi[r_][cc]==colv for cc in range(w)) else None
        stats.append((colv,drow,dcol))
    from collections import Counter as CT
    print(k, CT(stats))

import os,re,collections,itertools,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rest=t[m.end():]; rows=[]
        for line in rest.split('\n'):
            if not line.strip(): break
            parts=line.strip().split()
            if len(parts)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in parts): rows.append([int(x) for x in parts])
            else: break
        if len(rows)!=h: continue
        G[k]=rows
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))

import os,re,collections
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[]
    for line in t[m.end():].split('\n'):
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)!=w or not all(x.isdigit() for x in parts): continue
        rows.append([int(x) for x in parts])
        if len(rows)==h: break
    if len(rows)==h: G[k]=rows
def info(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    dom=max((y for y in cnt if y!=0),key=lambda y:cnt[y])
    # separator rows/cols: rows/cols >=90% zero? use >70%
    sr=[r_ for r_ in range(h) if sum(x==0 for x in gi[r_])>=0.7*w]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if sum(gi[r_][c]==0 for r_ in range(h))>=0.7*h]
    fills_by=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r_ in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if gi[r_][c]==0 and go[r_][c]!=0: fills_by[go[r_][c]].append((r_,c))
    print('===',k,'dom',dom,'dims',h,w)
    print('sep rows',sr)
    print('sep cols',sc)
    for col,cells in sorted(fills_by.items()):
        S=set(cells)
        for r,c in sorted(S):
            rowd=sorted(r_ for r_,c2 in cells if r_==r)
            cold=sorted(c2 for r2,c2 in cells if c2==c)
            # bracketed in row? (two dots of same color in row r, one <=c<=other, and c between consecutive dot cols)
            br=(any(c2<c for c2 in cold) and any(c2>c for c2 in cold)) if len(cold)>1 else False
            bc=(any(r2<r for r2 in rowd) and any(r2>r for r2 in rowd)) if len(rowd)>1 else False
            # between-consecutive: exists dots a<=b with a<c<b and no dot between
            br2=any(a<c<b for a,b in zip(cold,cold[1:]) if a<c and c<b)
            bc2=any(a<r<b for a,b in zip(rowd,rowd[1:]) if a<r and r<b)
            print(('S' if (r in sr) else '.')+(' ' if (c in sc) else ''),end='  ')
            print(col,'bracket_r',br,'brkt_consec_r',br2,'bracket_c',bc,'brkt_consec_c',bc2,
                  '| src',gi[r][c],'is_sep_row',r in sr,'is_sep_col',c in sc)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']: info(k)

import collections
for k in ['Demo pair 1']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']; h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
    dom=max((y for y in cnt if y!=0),key=lambda y:cnt[y])
    pts={c:[(r_,cc) for r_ in range(h) for cc in range(w) if gi[r_][c]==c] for c in set(cnt)-{dom,0}}
    print('markers:',{c:pts[c] for c in sorted(pts)})
    # per edge: which cells changed
    chg=[(r_,cc,gi[r_][cc],go[r_][cc]) for r_ in range(h) for cc in range(w) if gi[r_][cc]!=go[r_][cc]]
    bycol=collections.defaultdict(list); byrow=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for r_,cc,a,b in chg: byrow[r_].append(cc); bycol[cc].append(r_)
    for c in sorted(pts):
        P=pts[c]
        br=set(r_ for r_,cc in P); bc=set(cc for r_,cc in P)
        print(f'--- color {c}, marks {sorted(P)}')
        for r_ in sorted(byrow):
            cols_=byrow[r_]
            print('  row',r_, 'changed cols',sorted(cols_),'src',[gi[r_][x] for x in sorted(cols_)],'dst',[go[r_][x] for x in sorted(cols_)])

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']; h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r_ in gi for x in r_)
